title: Captain Vane says 'I'll bring the Company to the glade myself, when you're ready to lead the words' once I proposed the oath and later learned the Hanged Company's rest-verse from Keeper Rowan, but no dialogue option or location action ever appeared afterward (checked her tent and the hanging oak repeatedly) to actually hold the ceremony. The ending epilogue itself confirms it: 'The oath-stone still stands on the moor... waiting on a word that was never going to come.'
